USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_f_db.development.leaderboard (
  LEADERBOARD_ID    NUMBER AUTOINCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  PLAYER_NAME       VARCHAR(20),
  MODE              VARCHAR(10),
  SCORE             NUMBER,
  QUESTIONS_CLEARED NUMBER,
  CREATED_AT        TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
)
